checkpoint: Q: generated emitters light across a chunk border, order-independently
goal: A generated light source (lava, glowstone) in one chunk must light a neighbour, and a chunk streamed before its neighbour must be corrected when that neighbour is generated, without depending on send order.

changes.owner: GenSources lives in the connection's chunk window (Client.gen_sources), one entry per held chunk, removed on unload
changes.merge: block_light_sections reads the chunk and its eight neighbours' recorded generated emitters
changes.record: chunk_data records emitters that come from generated terrain (not the overlay) so a broken torch is not cached
changes.update: a new chunk marks an already-generated neighbour dirty when a source lies in the neighbour's search area; stream_chunks sends ClientboundLightUpdatePacket (0x2a) for held dirty chunks
changes.packet: sky omitted (it does not depend on emitters and the client leaves an unmasked section unchanged); zero block sections go in the empty mask with no array
changes.overlay_filter: a cached generated emitter is skipped once the overlay holds that cell, so a removed/replaced emitter stops lighting

contract.section_basis: adk builds section getMinLightSection()+i, matching LIGHT_MIN_Y/16+i
contract.unmasked_unchanged: ClientPacketListener.applyLightData only writes a section when its mask or empty mask bit is set

mutations: tools/mutation_check.sh: neighbour lookup -> self only (neighbour test red); generated source ignored (self test red); overlay filter disabled -> removed-emitter test red

runtime.datapack_view_2_move_one_chunk: 29 update-light packets, chunks (-2,-2)..(3,1); client decoded them

limits: The client probe is the repository's CLI decoder, not the vanilla client renderer; on-screen light parity remains for the excluded GUI path.
light_dirty_for over-approximates reach by x/z search area, so it may send an unnecessary update but never omits a needed one.
The packet carries full recomputed block light for the chunk, not vanilla's minimal changed-section set.
nonclaims: representative release performance of the update path
integration_review_fixes: Skip a cached generated emitter whose cell now has an overlay entry (Codex integration review P2).
